task_definition.task_description: Please look up headphones in electronics, check alternatives for the Sony WH-1000XM5 Black for me, pick the best recommended alternative, place a hold on one unit, and then confirm that order. After that, add one Sony WH-1000XM5 Black to my cart, then get the latest technology news, sort those headlines in descending order, and tell me the current UTC time.

Then get the latest news in the technology category, sort the headlines in descending order, and tell me the current time in timezone UTC.
